author: ClubberNugget
body:
Map: Grün Kaskade
Authors: Random_Guy (aka: Me)

This is my second map submission, I hope you find it fitting!

Welcome to Grün Kaskade!! A nice park that hikers and cavers alike visit!! It has a beautiful green mossy mountain for hikers and climbers to enjoy!!! It also has a fun tunnel course, or if your serious about caving, go through our cave, The Rätsel Cave, which is a labyrinth of ravines, lava pools and tunnels.  I hope you enjoy your stay here at Grün Kaskade, we also have a souvenir shop and history museum to get the fullest of the experience.


This map is unique because of its massive cave, its unique center, which has floating obsidian blocks containing nice treats in both the center and the walls ends.  This map also has a built in mini story!!!

Any feedback is appreciated, thanks for reading!!!

Map Download and YML: Here
Album: http://imgur.com/a/wQCK4

Change log:
1.1
YML Name Error Fixed
Hidden Weapons and Armor were nerfed
Obsidian swords were removed
Micah Juice was nerfed
Ender pearls were removed from the water and lava pools.
Map png was added
1.0.2
YML Regions and Walls Edited
1.0.1:
Fixed Doors and gates.
Nerfed the diamond swords at each wall end.

Alright, as requested, i have made a few changes to the map:
================================================================
>I fixed the name on the YML: http://pastebin.com/Gwu30QsY
================================================================
>I nerfed the hidden weapons and armor to:
Iz's helmet = respiration I
Derpy's Chestplate = thorns I
Ezno's Pants = protection I
Optic's Boots = Feather Falling I
Nebbsy's Bow (Was Kepii's bow) = Punch I
Megg's Sword (Was Micah's Sword) = Fire Aspect I
And the Middle potion, Micah Juice was given nausea to nerf the strength a little.
================================================================
>The Ender pearls hidden in the pools of lava and water were removed because it
provided poor gameplay.
================================================================
>The swords hidden in the Obsidian blocks were removed due to irrelevance.
================================================================
>Map png was added.
================================================================
Here is the new Download:
https://www.dropbox.com/sh/qp96x7up5ykez9t/AADn1TsGYKAAcku6Qh93K40sa?dl=0
================================================================
Thanks for the feedback!
